title: WeeklyAnnouncementsInput
description: Input data schema for generating weekly church announcements.

church_name.description: The name of the church (e.g., Redemption Community Church).

target_date.description: The Sunday or weekend date for these announcements (e.g., October 18, 2026).

tone.description: Desired tone (e.g., Warm & conversational, High energy, Traditional, Family-friendly).

primary_focus_item.description: The title of the #1 priority announcement that must be spotlighted on stage.

website_or_app_link.description: Central digital link or info desk location for calls to action.
website_or_app_link.default: our church app or the Info Desk in the lobby

title.description: Title of the ministry event or announcement.

target_audience.description: Who should attend (e.g., Young adults, All church, Parents).

action_item.description: The required next step (e.g., RSVP by Friday, Sign up to volunteer).
